title: Methane in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of CH₄ and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Four bonding regions surround carbon in a tetrahedral arrangement. Rotating the model shows that the four bonds do not all lie in one plane.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: Four bonding regions surround carbon in a tetrahedral arrangement. Rotating the model shows that the four bonds do not all lie in one plane.
